user.title: Eufy account
user.description: Your password is used once to log in and is not stored.

error.invalid_auth: Eufy refused the email or password.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum's map is already set up.
abort.no_vacuums: No vacuums found on this Eufy account.

init.title: Map options
init.description: Room names: type them as number=name, comma separated, e.g. 1=Living Room, 2=Hallway. The numbers are in the map camera's room_names attribute. Vacuum entity (optional) switches the map to fast updates as soon as cleaning starts.

command.name: Send command
command.description: Send a command to the X8 (testing). Needs 'Allow commands' on. Map-changing methods are always refused.

method.name: Method
method.description: e.g. goto, clear, or a cleaning method.

return_home.name: Return home
return_home.description: Send the X8 back to its dock. Needs 'Allow commands' on.

goto.name: Go to
goto.description: Send the X8 to a point (sends 'clear', waits 35 s, then 'goto'). Give x/y in robot units or pixel_x/pixel_y on the map. Needs 'Allow commands' on.
